notes.title: Rubber Hose Rampage Introduces Alice's Adventures in Wonderland!
notes.notes: [p]Rubber Hose Rampage just got curiouser and curiouser with its brand-new Alice in Wonderland level. This is no ordinary tea party, it's a full-on battle steeped in madness. The Queen of Hearts is ready to deal you in, the playing cards are stacked against you, and the Mad Hatter is pouring out trouble by the teacup. Luckily, Alice joins the fight, proving she's not just late for tea, she's early to stir up some trouble.[/p][p]Clear the new free bonus level and Alice will join your party, no tea required![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Introducing The Barnyard Battle!
notes.notes: [p]Sound the trumpets, Rubber Hose Rampage's wildest level yet, "The Barnyard Battle," has officially been unleashed! Inspired by the classic 1929 black-and-white short, this all-out animal army skirmish pits Mickey Mouse and his scrappy squadron of mice against the thunderous forces of Pete's Cat Army![/p][p]The new level is available now as a free update for all Rubber Hose Rampage players. Clear the eighth bonus level and get rewarded with the new Mousetrap weapon![/p]

notes.title: Introducing TinTin and Snowy!
notes.notes: [p]Comrade, join TinTin and his faithful dog Snowy on an adventure behind the Iron Curtain!  The seventh free Rubber Hose Rampage bonus level, TinTin in the Land of the Soviets, is available now!  Clear the level and get rewarded with TinTin and Snowy as a playable character![/p]

notes.title: Rubber Hose Rampage presents: The Plowboy
notes.notes: Welcome to the farm!  The sixth bonus level, The Plowboy, features Mickey Mouse, Minnie Mouse, Horace Horsecollar and Clarabelle having a good time on the farm.  Clear the sixth bonus level, The Plowboy, and get rewarded with Horace Horsecollar as a playable character!

notes.title: Rubber Hose Rampage presents: Winnie-The-Pooh and Some Bees!
notes.notes: The fifth free bonus level "Winnie-The-Pooh and Some Bees" featuring Winnie-The-Pooh, Christopher Robin, Piglet, Eeyore, Kanga, Roo, Owl, Rabbit, and Tigger is now available!  Pass the new level and receive the new Winnie-The-Pooh player skin!

notes.title: Boom Time, Baby!
notes.notes:
Rubber Hose Rampage just got even more chaotic! Along with your trusty guns, you now have a brand-new way to wreak havoc: throwable BOMBS! That's right, explosions are now part of your daily rampage. Just tap the shiny new bomb button to casually drop a little mayhem at your feet or hold it down to hurl destruction like a true lunatic.

Why settle for just bullets when you can blow stuff up too? Get out there and start flinging some fiery fun!

notes.title: Bonus Level 4: Felix the Cat in "The Goose that Laid the Golden Egg"
notes.notes: The fourth free bonus level "The Goose that Laid the Golden Egg" featuring Felix the Cat is now available!  The evil pirate Captain Kidd stole the Golden Goose from Felix.  Can you help Felix rescue the goose?  Pass the new level and receive the new Felix the Cat player skin!

notes.title: Introducing Four-Player Co-Op and Battle Arena Island!
notes.notes:
Rubber Hose Rampage can now have up to four players playing at the same time!  Grab your friends and play Rubber Hose Rampage today!  

Rubber Hose Rampage also added a new Player vs Player vs Player vs Player battle arena featuring three new arenas - Play with friends or automated chatbots.  This is an entirely new game mode!   

Rubber Hose Rampage's brings chaotic multiplayer battles, strategic bomb placements, and fast-paced gameplay!

Battle with up to 4 players and/or play against automated Chatbot Mickey!
Unleash powerful new bombs!
Master the arena and outsmart your opponents!

The bombs are ticking——are you ready to blast your way to victory?

notes.title: Bonus Level 3: A Date To Skate now available!
notes.notes: The third free bonus level "A Date To Skate" featuring Popeye the Sailor and Olive Oyl is now on Steam! This boss level is two phases of wacky fun. Pass the new level and receive the new Popeye the Sailor player skin!

notes.title: Hitbox updates
notes.notes: Went through the original levels and re-did the boss hitboxes using the animation hitbox update technique.

notes.title: Nerfed Wizard of Oz
notes.notes: Nerfed Wizard of Oz total health by 20%.

notes.title: Bonus Level 2: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
notes.notes: The second free bonus level "The Wonderful Wizard of Oz" is now on Steam!  This boss level is four phases and the first color level!  Pass the new level and receive the new Cyclone Creator gun!

notes.title: Introducing, Two Player!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826743/3cd45ea1c1607edcc48fafeaeaa41360c8caabd5.png[/img]

You can now play two player locally when two controllers are connected.  This update is available now!

notes.title: Oswald the Lucky Rabbit added as a playable character!
notes.notes:
An Oswald the Lucky Rabbit skin and a new achievement were added as a reward for passing the Oswald the Lucky Rabbit bonus level!  This change is now live with the newest update.

Other updates: 
Fixed Mickey Mouse character skin animation frames.
Changed hitboxes in the first Bee level.  
Added pause button text to maps.
Changed tutorial so can't skip chest.  
Added a bunch of death quotes from the first two Terminator movies. 
Fixed so last selected skin is still loaded when loading previous game.

notes.title: Rubber Hose Rampage introduces Oswald the Lucky Rabbit!
notes.notes: The first free bonus level "Oswald the Lucky Rabbit" is now live.  This boss level includes three phases of crazy wacky fun.  Can you beat Oswald?

notes.title: Changed compression
notes.notes: Changed compression to use LZ4 to lower file size to 800 MB.
